verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a browser-automation framework, so file download and upload is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents file downloads, file uploads, or retrieving artifacts afterwards. The nearest items cover cookie and local-storage persistence, clipboard access, and session recordings, which are different features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can download files from and upload files to the sites it operates, with the artifacts retrievable afterwards
